findings.title: Changes the light-theme link color
findings.body: The original rule used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but this replacement uses 70% for the light-theme branch. `dark-light-choose` selects that branch for light themes, so these links become substantially lighter than before and may have reduced contrast. Keep the primary branch at 30% and use the corresponding secondary-based value for dark themes.

findings.title: Changes the light-theme member-name color
findings.body: The original `.group-member-info .name` color used `$primary` at 30% lightness, but the replacement uses 50% in the light-theme branch. This changes the existing light-theme appearance and can reduce text contrast. Preserve the 30% primary value while choosing an appropriate secondary-based value for dark themes.

findings.title: Reverses the lightness values for the light-theme branch
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. This replacement uses 30% for the primary branch and 70% for the secondary branch, so light themes now get a darker color than before; the intended dark-theme counterpart is the secondary color at 30%. Keep the primary branch at 70%.

findings.title: Changes the light-theme topic-map heading color
findings.body: The original `h3` color used `$primary` at 20% lightness, but the replacement uses 50% in the light-theme branch. This changes the existing light-theme styling and may reduce heading contrast. Preserve the 20% primary value and use the corresponding secondary-based value for dark themes.

findings.title: Changes the light-theme member-name color
findings.body: The original `.group-member-info .name` color used `$primary` at 30% lightness, but this replacement uses 50% in the light-theme branch. Light themes therefore render these names lighter than before, potentially reducing contrast. Preserve the 30% primary value while adding the dark-theme secondary-based choice.
